name: Jack Viscer
source:
The smooth and flirty rook from Crimson, Jack knows exactly what he wants and how he wants it. But no matter how friendly he seems, there are shadows lurking in his heart and pain that sometimes flashes through his usually smiling eyes. His unhealed scars make it more difficult to get closer to him than it initially seems.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/steamberrystudio/gilded-shadows-a-gxb-sci-fi-adventure-otome-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
